comments.t: Little tip for super clean smooth cuts...start the hole with the drill in reverse (counter clockwise) for the first 1/16th" of an inch or so, then switch drill to forward (clockwise) and drill down till center guide bit pops through back side, flip board over, start cut in reverse for a second, then switch to forward and finish the cut! You will have clean crisp smoothe sides!
comments.creator_reply: That is an awesome tip, running it in reverse first definitely helps prevent tearout! Thanks brother.
